model_annotations.Bulgarian: Figure 4 illustrates the mean absolute values of hidden states before and after gating, across different layers of a neural network. The graph displays three distinct lines, each representing a different condition: the hidden state mean before gating (dashed line, average 0.71), the hidden state mean after gating (dotted line, average 0.05), and the hidden state mean of the baseline (solid line, average 0.04). The horizontal axis, labeled "Layer," is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, with numerical tick marks at intervals of 5. The vertical axis, labeled "Abs Mean," is also linear, spanning from 0 to 4, with tick marks at intervals of 1. The dashed line (before gating) starts at approximately 0.71 at Layer 0 and remains nearly flat across all layers, with a slight increase toward Layer 20. The dotted line (after gating) begins at approximately 0.05 and remains nearly constant across all layers, showing minimal variation. The solid line (baseline) starts at approximately 0.04 and also remains nearly flat across the entire range of layers. All three lines are closely aligned, particularly in the latter layers, indicating that the mean absolute values before and after gating are similar, as stated in the caption.
